@args: projected Pig Kingdom decision without persistence

WITNESS.title: The Lantern Moth
WITNESS.ability: Carries one verified testimony through a blackout.

warning.title: The Missing Names
warning.text: The donkey finds a casualty ledger that the Royal Council removed from the public archive. Families from both sides appear in its margins, but the seal is incomplete and the valley is still occupied.

choices.label: Verify the ledger with independent witnesses
choices.record: Required corroboration before accusing any faction.

choices.label: Publish every allegation immediately
choices.detail: Rapid attention; unverified names may put families at risk.
choices.record: Claimed evidence mattered while circulating allegations that had not been checked.

choices.label: Move families first, then release the record
choices.detail: Protects civilians while preserving the original evidence.
choices.record: Placed immediate civilian safety before publicity without destroying the evidence.

royal_decree.title: The Children of the Valley
royal_decree.text: The Council orders another bombardment. Soldiers may be in the valley, but hundreds of families remain. The general says delay will endanger the kingdom. The donkey asks whether the order would stand if the Council's children lived below.

choices.label: Negotiate monitored safe passage
choices.detail: Delay the strike and let neutral witnesses count each evacuation.
choices.record: Applied the civilian-protection rule regardless of family or faction.

choices.label: Accept the decree as military necessity
choices.detail: Preserve command unity and conceal the unresolved civilian count.
choices.record: Called every child equal while accepting a risk leaders would not impose on their own families.

choices.label: Evacuate only families loyal to the rebellion
choices.detail: Protect allies while abandoning children labeled as enemies.
choices.record: Limited an absolute protection principle to politically favored children.

independent_review.title: The Empty Throne
independent_review.text: The Queen's rule collapses. The rebellion can seize the castle, publish the record, or bind every future leader—including the donkey—to independent review.

choices.label: Create an independent civilian-protection court
choices.detail: Open evidence, equal jurisdiction, rotating reviewers, and appeals.
choices.record: Accepted scrutiny under the same institution created to judge the former Council.

choices.label: Let the donkey decide until the crisis ends
choices.detail: Fast decisions with no independent appeal.
choices.record: Condemned unreviewable decrees, then claimed one was necessary under new leadership.

choices.label: Declare every pig guilty
choices.record: Demanded individual proof from enemies, then assigned guilt by identity when power changed hands.
